name: Irina Volkov
bio: Irina's fascination with motorsport began during her childhood, captivated by the intricate electronics that powered Formula 1 cars. She pursued a degree in Electrical Engineering at Moscow State University, specializing in advanced control systems. After graduation, Irina gained valuable experience at a local engineering firm, focusing on embedded systems development. Seeking a more challenging and dynamic environment, she transitioned to motorsport, initially working on data acquisition systems for a smaller racing team before joining Akkodis ASP Team. Irina's approach to electronics engineering is rooted in a blend of rigorous analysis and creative problem-solving. Her focus is on optimizing electronic performance to achieve a competitive advantage on the track. She's particularly known for her ability to diagnose complex electrical issues swiftly and efficiently, often devising innovative solutions under pressure.

physical.hairStyle: Long, straight hair often pulled back in a practical ponytail
physical.description: Irina is a slender woman with sharp, intelligent eyes and a focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a multi-tool on her person, even off-track
Has a habit of sketching circuit diagrams on napkins during meetings
Prefers to listen to electronic music while working to enhance focus
